themes.name: 无法确定
themes.problem: 缺乏具体技术手段描述

evidence.quote: PURPOSE:To prevent the sticking of only toner to the surface of a developing roller even if the concentration of the toner is high by providing a means applying a potential, with respect to a member disposed on the circumference of the developing roller, in a developing device using a two-component developer.

PURPOSE:To provide a developing device which can form a uniform toner layer on the surface of a developing roll and obtain an excellent image without defective image quality caused by hysteresis or the like.
【課題】  トナーカートリッジの洗浄を、短時間で確実に行うことが可能なトナーカートリッジ洗浄方法を得る。
